questions.q: Code on main changed, but a page still looks old on production. What are the first two things to separate? Choose the best.
options: Whether aem.live is new, and whether the production CDN is
Whether the author's document was saved after the last code merge to main
questions.explain: Check each tier in order to find where the old copy is.

questions.q: A brand refresh changes colours everywhere. What makes this a small change?
options: Design tokens as CSS custom properties
A separate CSS file per block and per brand colour, swapped in by metadata
questions.explain: One token change updates its users.

questions.q: A Universal Editor field should combine an image and its alt text in one element. Which feature applies?
questions.explain: Suffixes such as Alt combine properties.

questions.q: A pull request has failing PageSpeed checks, and a deadline looms. What should happen?
options: Fix it, or record an explicit exception by its owner
Disable the check for the whole repository until the release is over

questions.q: An image conveys a key instruction, and the author leaves alt text empty. What is the problem?
options: Screen reader users miss the information
Lighthouse fails the page, but readers lose nothing
The page fails to publish from Sidekick
The image is stretched to fill the empty alt space
questions.explain: Meaningful images need useful alt text.

questions.q: Translated pages keep drifting from their originals. What should the program define?
options: A source of truth, and a translation workflow
A weekly full re-translation of the whole site, without review
A separate site for each translator

questions.q: An author asks to A/B test a headline. Which is the right framing first?
options: A hypothesis, a primary metric and enough traffic
Change it for a week, then compare total sales with last week's numbers
Test ten headlines on a low-traffic page

questions.q: A profile sets a security header, and one site removes it through its own configuration. Which applies?
Two hours before launch, someone wants to change the code location. What should you do?
options: Stop it, and keep the configuration frozen
Do it, but purge everything first so the new location is used straight away
questions.explain: Adobe advises against late location changes.

questions.q: A leaked Admin API key is found in Git history. What is the right first action?
options: Revoke it, then review the audit log
Delete the line and move on
Make the repository private and keep the key

questions.q: A snapshot is approved while the code it needs has not merged. What should the team have done?
options: Publish the pages by hand, and add the code later in the day

questions.q: After migration, organic traffic falls and Search Console reports many 404s. What is your first step?
options: Add redirects for valuable missing URLs
Reduce the sitemap to only those pages that still rank
questions.explain: Compare what is missing with real demand.

questions.q: Pages are generated from JSON, and a record is deleted at source. What must be planned?
options: A flow that unpublishes the page
Nothing, the page disappears with the next rebuild of the index
questions.explain: Generated pages stay live until removed.

questions.q: A designer proposes an auto-rotating six-slide hero. What do you raise?
options: Accessibility, LCP, and whether it is needed
Only the number of slides and the image file sizes, as rotation is a design choice
questions.explain: Motion needs pause controls, and carousels often hide content.

questions.q: You want to contribute a client’s block to open source. What comes first?
options: Remove client material, and confirm your rights
Rename the company in the code, then open a pull request straight away
